diff --git a/debian/patches/verify-upki.patch b/debian/patches/verify-upki.patch
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..4f64c6d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/debian/patches/verify-upki.patch
@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+From 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
+From: Julian Andres Klode <juliank@ubuntu.com>
+Date: Jun, 15 2026 16:45:04 +0200
+Subject: [PATCH] Verify upki by default
+
+Forwarded: not-needed
+
+--- a/ssl/ssl_cert.c
++++ b/ssl/ssl_cert.c
+@@ -27,6 +27,7 @@
+ #include "ssl_cert_table.h"
+ #include "internal/thread_once.h"
+ #include "internal/ssl_unwrap.h"
++#include <dlfcn.h>
+ #ifndef OPENSSL_NO_POSIX_IO
+ #include <sys/stat.h>
+ #ifdef _WIN32
+@@ -60,6 +61,21 @@ int SSL_get_ex_data_X509_STORE_CTX_idx(v
+     return ssl_x509_store_ctx_idx;
+ }
+ 
++static void *upki_openssl = NULL;
++static SSL_verify_cb upki_openssl_verify_callback = NULL;
++
++static CRYPTO_ONCE upki_openssl_once = CRYPTO_ONCE_STATIC_INIT;
++
++DEFINE_RUN_ONCE_STATIC(upki_openssl_init)
++{
++    upki_openssl = dlopen("/usr/lib/" DEB_HOST_MULTIARCH "/libupki_openssl.so.1", RTLD_LAZY);
++    if (upki_openssl != NULL) {
++        upki_openssl_verify_callback =
++            (SSL_verify_cb) dlsym(upki_openssl, "upki_openssl_verify_callback");
++    }
++    return upki_openssl != NULL && upki_openssl_verify_callback != NULL;
++}
++
+ CERT *ssl_cert_new(size_t ssl_pkey_num)
+ {
+     CERT *ret = NULL;
+@@ -499,6 +515,8 @@ static int ssl_verify_internal(SSL_CONNE
+ 
+     if (s->verify_callback)
+         X509_STORE_CTX_set_verify_cb(ctx, s->verify_callback);
++    else if (RUN_ONCE(&upki_openssl_once, upki_openssl_init))
++        X509_STORE_CTX_set_verify_cb(ctx, upki_openssl_verify_callback);
+ 
+     if (sctx->app_verify_callback != NULL) {
+         i = sctx->app_verify_callback(ctx, sctx->app_verify_arg);
